# V2 reuse matrix: intake decisions

Source: `REFERENCE_REUSE_MATRIX.md` (44 entries, Part 7 of handoff RASANAI-SEQUENCED-V2-2026-10-25, Heresay brief r_-fPv0AYNHmYENKpt), read as data. Written 2026-10-25 from the repo's own records only: `SOURCES.md`, `INTAKE.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, `license-register.json`, `docs/plans/motion-studio-licenses.md`, `docs/plans/hybrid-film-contracts.md` and the Plan 08 K8 table in `docs/plans/RULE_MIGRATION_MAP.md`. No network, no clone, no upstream file read for this document.

Policy applied (INTAKE.md): nothing imported or copied from any entry here. Where a licence is not recorded in this repo, it is `unresolved`, never assumed permissive. A matrix row, README claim, badge or star count is not licence evidence. A pointer is not a dependency.

Status words: **recorded** = a full decision already exists elsewhere (pointer given); **partial** = decided only in a table or a loose group row, or only one half of the row is covered; **new** = no decision existed before this file, so the default below is recorded.

Default for every **new** entry: `ideas only - nothing imported or copied, licence unverified`.

Fields per row: source, pin (file/commit/digest), licence evidence, mode, RasanAI destination, scoped rule ids, status, decision, where recorded. Review date for new rows: 2026-10-25 (records review only). Separate media/font/model rights: unresolved for every row unless the cited record says otherwise. Runtime/version: none for any row (no dependency added).

Rule ids: only Plan 08 K ids exist (RULE_MIGRATION_MAP.md). Elsewhere the matrix names plan numbers only; ids are not yet assigned and are written `plan NN (ids not assigned)`.
